questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Metagonimus yokogawai?
options: Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
questions.explanation: Small operculated eggs in stool. Stool concentration and wet mounts near 400×; supplement species identification with appropriate confirmatory methods.
